---
title: "Aggregate states"
subtitle: "Sum across all eight Australian states and territories"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

agg <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_aggregate), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
```

::: {.callout-note}
Aggregate views sum flow variables (revenue, expenses, capex) and
stock variables (net debt) across all eight jurisdictions. They
should be treated as approximate while Phase 2 extraction is
incomplete --- the sum reflects whatever subset of states has been
extracted so far.
:::

```{r}
if (nrow(agg) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No aggregate panel yet.")
} else {
  agg |>
    filter(variable_id == "net_debt", !is_forward_estimate) |>
    arrange(fiscal_year) |>
    plot_ly(x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value_aud_mil,
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            name = "All states & territories") |>
    sbm_theme_fiscal(
      title       = "Aggregate net debt",
      yaxis_title = "AUD millions"
    )
}
```

## Aggregate fact table

```{r}
if (nrow(agg) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("Empty.")
} else {
  agg |>
    arrange(variable_id, fiscal_year) |>
    select(variable_id, canonical_label, fiscal_year, value_aud_mil, n_states) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE
    )
}
```
